identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase II Trial of LM103 for Adjuvant Treatment in Patients With Non-small Cell Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Controlled, Open-label, Phase IIa Trial on Autologous Tumor Infiltrating Lymphocyte Injection (LM103 TILs) for the Adjuvant Treatment of Non-small Cell Lung Cancer With Negative Driver Gene Mutations

descriptionModule.briefSummary: After receiving neoadjuvant treatment with PD-1 antibody and undergoing radical resection, a total 36 to 45 NSCLC patients who met the inclusion criteria, will be randomly assigned in a 1:1:1 ratio to the experimental group 1, experimental group 2 and the control group in this Phase IIa clinical trial. The study will be followed up until 24 to 36 months after treatment.

interventions.name: LM103 TILs Injection
interventions.description: Extract, culture and expand tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes from resected tumor tissues in vitro for the manufactur of LM103 TILs injection. After NMA-LD, the subjects received LM103 infusion and followed by IL-2 supportive treatment.

interventions.name: PD-1 / PD-L1 monoclonal antibody
interventions.description: Received PD-1 antibody treatment according to the instructions.

primaryOutcomes.description: AEs will be recorded and assessed according to CTCAE Version 6.0
Based on pathological diagnosis or imaging results
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Every 12 weeks from treatment to 24~36 months
